children.value: > Fact From Story: Joshua Dobbs threw four interceptions in the Vikings' 12-10 "Monday Night Football" loss to the Bears
> > Fact From Story: the Vikings led a sluggish offense that didn't find its footing until the fourth quarter in a game that Minnesota wouldn't have needed many points to win.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: An offense that does not find its footing will struggle to score points.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Throwing interceptions is detrimental to a team's success in a football game.
